items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: I got into Charlie Christian. I liked his style because he played on it. ... Well who did Charlie Christian play with? Charlie Christian and his brother and all that bunch, he just was a guy that would be out there, a musical family.

ctx.x: The one you know, yeah. No, the young one. The one was here now, you know. Yeah, not his daddy. No, he was playing clarinet, Jerry Green was playing bass, and Raymond Carlis was playing drums. And we won the contest. Out of all those bands, well I came in with the swing, Professor Victor come in with the sweet music, and Henry Hardin, he come in with the best dressed band. And Salestand and Joe Rocio and them were, it was automatically mentioned. Well I had a band similar to, at that time, we was on the style of…
